review.note: This contract is data, versioned outside the runtime. It must never be authored by the runtime under test.

entailment.rationale: A CAUSES B entails a directed relation from cause to effect; the direction is not reversible.
The cause must become salient no later than the effect; the effect cannot precede its cause.
Causal narration resolves onto the effect, not the cause, at the end of the beat.
